site_name: Isleworth And Syon School For Boys
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The hereby approved structure shall comply with Building Bulletin 93 in terms of the acoustic performance requirement of the new school building.
Condition : 5 - Any construction works shall comply with best practice, as set out in BS5228: Noise and vibration control on construction and open sites.
Condition : 6 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 24/5/2012 when the use shall cease
description: Erection of two storey mobile classroom in place of existing single storey mobile classroom to school
